scene_summary: A parchment-ground illustration splits into two ornate groups: a large white-furred ape face beneath a sweeping jeweled white hat, wrapped in cobalt surf on the left; face-bearing orchids, branching growth, a bound broom and a crowned bulb above smaller waves on the right. Three bees cross the gap, and a floral seal with red brush marks sits below. The planned white-fur and wave overlap is clearly visible.
usable_surfaces: Scalloped white-fur edge spilling over the large cobalt wave beneath the hat

detected_objects.label: Long white fur spilling from beneath the sweeping hat brim across a cobalt wave
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Below the broad white hat brim, a pale lock sweeps from the left shoulder across the dark blue wave, widening into layered strands beneath the muzzle and tapering into a dangling curl at the lower right. The polygon follows this localized white-fur gesture rather than enclosing the whole head, hat or surf. The orchids, bees and smaller faces are subordinate elements of the same planned artwork, not additional source assignments.

complexity_assessment.rationale: Two dominant groups are separated by parchment gaps, but both contain dense engraved-looking detail. Jewels, individual fur strands, foam curls, several faces, bees, botanical veins, rope and a floral seal make the plate ornate and illustrative rather than minimal and expressionist. The single mapped overlap remains visually distinct.
